modules.name: Recipes to Fill the Stomach and Heart
modules.description: A warmly curated collection of family favorites, from comforting Italian classics and hearty main dishes to homemade breads, sauces, sweets, and drinks.

modules.name: Breakfast & Brunch
modules.description: A complete breakfast collection of griddle favorites, egg dishes, hearty gravies, casseroles, handheld meals, breads, and make-ahead mornings.

modules.name: Everyday Sides
modules.description: A versatile collection of potatoes, salads, slaws, vegetables, casseroles, rice, noodles, holiday favorites, and classic breads for completing family meals.

modules.name: Spices, Sauces & Kitchen Foundations
modules.description: A practical collection of homemade seasoning blends, mustards, condiments, gravies, dipping sauces, and versatile cooking foundations designed to connect recipes across the kitchen.

modules.name: Slow Cooker Favorites
modules.description: A dependable collection of classic slow-cooker comfort food, family dinners, soups, sandwiches, pasta, and original flavor-forward creations.
